mapper.select: INSERT INTO generation_tasks (novel_id, from_chapter, to_chapter, submitted_by, kind, payload) VALUES (#{novelId}, #{fromChapter}, #{toChapter}, #{submittedBy}, #{kind}, #{payload}::jsonb) RETURNING id

SELECT t.id, t.novel_id AS "novelId", n.title AS "novelTitle", t.from_chapter AS "fromChapter", t.to_chapter AS "toChapter", t.status, t.done_chapters AS "doneChapters", t.current_chapter AS "currentChapter", t.last_message AS "lastMessage", to_char(t.create_time, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS "createTime", COALESCE(t.kind, 'CHAPTERS') AS "kind", t.payload::text AS "payload" FROM generation_tasks t JOIN novels n ON n.id = t.novel_id WHERE t.is_deleted = FALSE ORDER BY CASE WHEN t.status IN ('QUEUED', 'RUNNING') THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, t.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT id FROM generation_tasks WHERE status = 'QUEUED' ORDER BY id LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE generation_tasks SET status='RUNNING', current_chapter=from_chapter, update_time=now() WHERE id=#{id} AND status='QUEUED'
mapper.select: SELECT t.id, t.novel_id AS "novelId", n.title AS "novelTitle", t.from_chapter AS "fromChapter", t.to_chapter AS "toChapter", t.status, t.done_chapters AS "doneChapters", t.current_chapter AS "currentChapter", t.last_message AS "lastMessage", to_char(t.create_time, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS "createTime", COALESCE(t.kind, 'CHAPTERS') AS "kind", t.payload::text AS "payload" FROM generation_tasks t JOIN novels n ON n.id = t.novel_id WHERE t.status = 'RUNNING' ORDER BY t.id LIMIT 1

SELECT t.id, t.novel_id AS "novelId", n.title AS "novelTitle", t.from_chapter AS "fromChapter", t.to_chapter AS "toChapter", t.status, t.done_chapters AS "doneChapters", t.current_chapter AS "currentChapter", t.last_message AS "lastMessage", to_char(t.create_time, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS "createTime", COALESCE(t.kind, 'CHAPTERS') AS "kind", t.payload::text AS "payload" FROM generation_tasks t JOIN novels n ON n.id = t.novel_id WHERE t.status = 'RUNNING' ORDER BY t.id

SELECT t.id FROM generation_tasks t WHERE t.status = 'QUEUED' AND t.is_deleted = FALSE AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM generation_tasks r WHERE r.novel_id = t.novel_id AND r.status = 'RUNNING') ORDER BY t.id LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT novel_id) FROM generation_tasks WHERE status = 'RUNNING' AND is_deleted = FALSE

SELECT t.id, t.novel_id AS "novelId", n.title AS "novelTitle", t.from_chapter AS "fromChapter", t.to_chapter AS "toChapter", t.status, t.done_chapters AS "doneChapters", t.current_chapter AS "currentChapter", t.last_message AS "lastMessage", to_char(t.create_time, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS "createTime", COALESCE(t.kind, 'CHAPTERS') AS "kind", t.payload::text AS "payload" FROM generation_tasks t JOIN novels n ON n.id = t.novel_id WHERE t.id = #{id}
